consequence.statement: Loki metrics that previously had the `cortex_` prefix will now have the `loki_` prefix by default, requiring updates to metric scrape configurations, dashboards, and alerting rules that reference these metrics by name.

assertion.statement: Loki 3.0.0 changes metrics namespace prefix from `cortex_` to `loki_`; the `metrics_namespace` config key can be set to `cortex` to retain the old prefix, but this setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release.
